title: SAMHSA: 2024 public-use codebook
annotation: Exact variables, coding, screening and imputation notes; downloaded and inspected.

title: SAMHSA: 2024 Data Users’ Guide
annotation: Weighting, domain estimation, variance estimation and reporting rules; downloaded and inspected.

title: Gobbi et al. (2019): adolescent cannabis and later depression, anxiety and suicidality
annotation: Systematic review and meta-analysis. Useful background on timing; its adolescent longitudinal evidence differs from this adult cross-sectional design. Observational confounding remains relevant.

title: Han et al. (2021): cannabis, depression status and suicidality
annotation: NSDUH analysis of adults aged 18–34. Shows established overlap among these topics; suicidality is not the proposed primary outcome. Older diagnostic and survey periods require comparability checks.

title: The Longitudinal Association of Cumulative Depression With Cannabis Use Disorder Among Young Adults (2024)
annotation: Longitudinal study of 4,407 young adults. Priority reading for temporal ordering and shared vulnerability; full-text appraisal pending.

title: Young Adult Depression and Cannabis Use: Associations Before and After Recreational Legalization (2024)
annotation: State-level NSDUH prevalence analysis, 2008–2019. Useful policy-design comparison; ecological findings do not identify individual effects or Bangladesh policy consequences.

title: Khan et al. (2020): psychosocial factors and substance use in Bangladesh
annotation: Bangladesh GSHS analysis. Direct local context, but composite other-substance outcomes must not be treated as cannabis use disorder.

title: Addictive behavior and mental health of adolescents in Bangladesh (2024)
annotation: Prior Bangladesh GSHS mental-health analysis. Check overlap before making a novelty claim; adolescent school data differ from adult national data.

title: Al-Mamun et al. (2024): substance use among admission test-takers
annotation: Local young-person context with limited generalizability. Data are available on request, not an unrestricted public download.

title: WHO: Bangladesh GSHS 2014 catalog
annotation: Public-use school survey with drug-use and mental-health items; not current adult surveillance.

title: WHO: Bangladesh current marijuana question Q42
annotation: Only 21 unweighted current-use reports among 2,941 valid records in the catalog. These are file counts, not population prevalence.

title: Bangladesh student substance-use dataset (2026)
annotation: Public repository description; cannabis-specific fields, license and recruitment still need file-level review.

title: FDA: cannabis research and drug approval
annotation: Distinguishes specific approved cannabinoid medicines from whole-plant cannabis. NSDUH cannot establish therapeutic efficacy.

title: STROBE reporting guidance
annotation: Use the cross-sectional checklist for transparent reporting; it is a reporting guide, not a quality score.

title: R survey package documentation
annotation: Official package entry point. Review svydesign, subset, svyglm and confidence-interval documentation.

title: UNLV Health Sciences Research Symposium submission rules
annotation: Current event eligibility, submission format, results requirement and notification date.

title: UNLV Health Sciences Research Symposium home
annotation: Event date, location and free registration.
